text: The User Interface Designer will design a menu for all functions.
The meeting highlighted that current remote controls have disliked look-and-feel and usability, are hard to learn, and remotes can get lost.
There will be two function groups: simple functions for the broad public and advanced options for younger users.

Teletext is not required except for TV, and teletext and the newsflash feature will not be used in the future; the product must keep all classic remote functions and improve button usability and physical design, with corporate identity including logo and colors.
The PM will write the minutes, the UI Designer will group functions into display and basic groups and compile LCD menu, and the ID will integrate channel-changing functionality.
